name: Ring of Deflection
body:
Aura strong abjuration; CL 13th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of spell turning and functions as such with one exception: instead of returning the spell to the caster, the spell is deflected to the individual closest to the wearer.

This ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of spell turning

Identification DC 38
False Identification DC 28
